snippet.title: Settler's Domain - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Manage your ever-growing settlement! Use the resources at your disposal to build structures necessary for survival. Research new structures with a variety of functionalities. When resources grow scarce, explore your surroundings for more. Encounter other settlements and deal with them using diplomacy or hostility. Create sprawling settlements, organized central villages, or anything in between- whatever works to expand your domain.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3396920/Settlers_Domain/

Developer: rick

#indiegame #citybuilder #colonysim
